messages: maya: Quick a11y sweep of the Insights table — found a few low-hanging issues: contrast on secondary meta text, pagination focus ring is barely visible on high-contrast prefs, keyboard trap in the filter flyout, toast announcements not being read by SRs, and missing aria-labels on svg status icons. olivia: thanks — can you paste screenshots or snippets? which pages/viewport sizes? :eyes: maya: main /insights page, desktop 1440 and 1280. Quick screenshots in thread, but here's the condensed list so we can triage. maya: 1) secondary meta color token is `--muted-text` (#6b7280) — fails WCAG AA on white bg. 2) pagination focus uses box-shadow with 0.5px blur, effectively invisible at 200% zoom. 3) filter flyout traps tab when search input is empty. 4) toasts use `role="alert"` + `aria-live="assertive"` and sometimes suppress previous message reads. 5) svg icons missing `aria-hidden` + title fallback. samir: re: 1 and 2, i can swap tokens and tighten focus. propose `--muted-text: #4b5563` and focus outline `3px solid #005fcc`. samir: quick css patch: ```css :root { --muted-text: #4b5563; --focus-ring: 3px solid #005fcc; } .table__meta { color: var(--muted-text); } .pagination button:focus { outline: var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } ``` ryan: for toasts, let's avoid `role="alert"` unless it's critical. `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` gives better SR behavior for quick successive toasts. ryan: also add `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative svgs and use visually hidden labels for status-only icons: `Healthy` maya: good call. the flyout trap feels like an autofocus issue — when search is empty shift focus to first focusable and allow escape to close. also ensure `tabindex="-1"` on non-interactive wrappers. olivia: can we get a small checklist to create tickets? rough priority and estimates? maya: yes — - P1 (1d): pagination focus ring + muted-text contrast - P1 (half day): toast aria change + atomic - P2 (1d): filter flyout tab trap + escape handling - P3 (half day): svg aria-hidden / sr-only labels samir: i'll do pagination + muted token today, open PR and tag @ryan for review. a11y-bot: Automated contrast check: after token change, simulated AA passes on desktop 14px but still needs verification at 12px. ryan: i'll review live on device and run VoiceOver/JAWS pass. tagging accessibility checklist in tickets. maya: thanks team — i'll file the tickets in Jira and add steps to reproduce and screenshots. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup: olivia: nice, sounds actionable. roll this into the next design sprint grooming. samir: PR coming in ~2h. <3 maya: closing thread for now — follow ups in the Jira tickets. cheers.
